observed.source: Codex session rollout (CLI-recorded thread settings; not model-authored)

result.decision_rationale: The candidate meets all five requirements on the Windows development host. The recorded remote branch head, reviewed snapshot, and passing unit gate identify the same commit. All 14 list-command tests passed, including the cases for a held writer lock, an empty registry, and damaged entries alongside a healthy enrollment.

executed_verification: Verified the snapshot HEAD with Git. The CLI-recorded developer transcript shows that the remote claude/list-command branch pointed to the same commit before the gate ran.

The pinned controller ran verify --gate unit on the candidate and recorded exit 0 with the worktree unchanged. The log SHA-256 matches the receipt. The suite ran 205 tests, with only the opt-in live-model smoke skipped.

The passing fixture tests checked exact output fields, enrollment ordering, an unchanged filesystem snapshot while the writer lock was held, damaged-entry diagnostics, and refusal when a populated registry could not be enumerated.
Git showed that the two commits after the round-four candidate added only 17 review records under docs/agent-reviews/pr-2/.
inspected: The fixed mission, repository instructions, operating guide, protocol, full feature diff, and surrounding registry, state-read, and CLI dispatch code.
The developer report, CLI-recorded transcript, prior findings ledger, and candidate-bound unit receipt and log. The ledger has no pending findings.
limitations: Runtime observations come from the recorded Windows gate. This independent review used read-only inspection.

Path inspection and file opening are separate operations. A concurrent link replacement can change the path between them. A positively mapped network drive was untested, and the implementation does not detect POSIX network mounts.
source_inspection_only: The list command reads claims and state directly, without entering controller locking, writing, Git, or GitHub code. New claims retain the existing dir field and add an absolute state_dir for listing from other working directories.
The README places list beside status and documents the output fields, damaged-entry diagnostics, and registry refusal behavior.

summary.delivered_behavior: An owner can run list without an enrollment ID to see a sorted JSON array of registered enrollments and their status, phase, PR number, and update time. A damaged entry remains visible with status unknown and a diagnostic. An empty registry prints [], while an unreadable registry produces an explicit error.
remaining_owner_review: Review the controller’s final handoff on draft PR #2 and decide whether to merge and install the candidate.
summary.scope_reviewed: The complete list-command mission, including behavior tests, documentation, compatibility with existing claim readers, and required validation on the pushed candidate.
